prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map separates the near vehicle interior—door frames, roof pillars, dashboard, and front-seat occupant, roughly 0.3–1.5 m away—from the darker exterior: the blue vehicle at about 2–4 m and the storefront and signs roughly 10–20 m ahead. It shows the occupant to the left/front of the camera wearer, with the dashboard below, windshield ahead, and exterior vehicle and building beyond; the nearby interior structure partly occludes the outdoor scene. Across the five frames, changes are dominated by camera turning: the near pillars and occupant shift laterally while the storefront remains distant, with no clear large approach or retreat. The map makes near/far layering clearer than RGB, but it has no metric scale, merges many distant surfaces into similarly dark regions, and produces unstable, overly bright boundaries around pillars and people.
descriptions.segmentation: The segmentation map identifies cars in frames 1, 4, and 5, people in frames 2 and 4, and a large motorcycle-labelled region in frame 2, while most of the vehicle interior, storefront, and signs remain unlabeled black. With RGB context, the detected nearby person is inside the camera wearer’s vehicle at roughly 0.5–1.2 m, the detected exterior cars are approximately 2–4 m away, and the building is farther ahead at roughly 10–20 m; the person and exterior cars are therefore separated by several metres and by the windshield or side window. The masks clarify left/right occupancy and occlusion—for example, the person occupies the left/front interior and partly blocks the dashboard and exterior view—but they do not provide depth, facing direction, gaze, or reliable arm’s-reach information by themselves. Across frames the masks appear and disappear mainly as the viewpoint turns and objects become occluded or leave the field of view, and the oversized car regions in frame 1, the motorcycle label in frame 2, fragmented bodies, and missed detections make the map unreliable.
descriptions.pose: The pose map detects only magenta hand skeletons, mainly near the centre of frame 3 and right-of-centre in frame 4; no dependable yellow body skeleton is visible. RGB context places these hands on the nearby front-seat occupant, approximately 0.5–1 m from the camera wearer and above the dashboard, so they are within that person’s reach and plausibly within about an arm’s length of the camera wearer, while the exterior vehicle and storefront are several metres beyond reach. The hand location shifts rightward from frame 3 to frame 4 and disappears by frame 5, consistent with relative hand or camera motion and later occlusion or detector loss; the cropped body remains left/front of the camera, but facing direction and gaze cannot be established reliably. The map reveals articulated hand position that is difficult to distinguish against the dark RGB interior, yet it supplies no depth, misses most bodies and hands, and cannot resolve what is behind an occluder or outside the frame.
